analysis.project_title: Sensepass Retail - E-Commerce Checkout & Automated Vendor Fulfillment

metadata.attendees: Elena Rostova (Client, Head of Operations at Sensepass Retail), Marcus Bennett (Lead Consultant, AI Tech Consulting), Maya Lin (Senior Solutions Architect)

requirements.description: Stripe payment gateway integration with on-site embedded checkout for credit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
requirements.source_passage: We want Stripe as our primary payment gateway, accepting credit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay with on-site embedded checkout.
requirements.speaker: Elena Rostova
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Transactions process on-site via Stripe API without off-site redirects.

requirements.description: PayPal Commerce Platform integration with embedded Smart Payment Buttons.
requirements.source_passage: PayPal supported as a secondary option... Embedded on-site through PayPal Commerce Platform, definitely.
requirements.speaker: Elena Rostova
requirements.acceptance_criteria: On-site PayPal checkout modal executes without external redirect.

requirements.description: Multi-tier vendor plans with 14-day free trial (credit card upfront auto-renew) and annual billing.
requirements.source_passage: Basic Vendor plan that has a 14-day free trial requiring a credit card upfront that automatically rolls over into a $49/month charge; and Premium Supplier billed at $490/year.
requirements.speaker: Elena Rostova
requirements.acceptance_criteria: 14-day free trial captures card upfront and initiates auto-renew on day 15.

requirements.description: Admin-managed full and partial refund processing with member subscription lifecycle handling.
requirements.source_passage: Our staff need the ability to issue full or partial refunds directly... If a vendor cancels their subscription, their catalog should remain visible until the paid billing cycle concludes.
requirements.speaker: Elena Rostova
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Admins can trigger full or partial refunds from Transaction History modal.

requirements.description: Automated transaction notification emails and real-time webhook export to ERP.
requirements.source_passage: Whenever a successful payment occurs, we need real-time webhooks fired to our ERP database and an automated notification sent via email to the vendor.
requirements.speaker: Elena Rostova
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Webhooks post payment payloads to ERP endpoint with retry logging.

explicit_exclusions: Custom physical inventory warehouse barcode scanner hardware integration.

feasibility_results.justification: Natively integrated in Brilliant Directories under Finance > Payment Gateways. Supports on-site credit card processing, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and webhook signing secret validation.

scope_of_work.project_title: Sensepass Retail - E-Commerce Checkout & Automated Vendor Fulfillment
scope_of_work.project_objective: Deliver a high-performance, conversion-optimized directory portal for Elena Rostova (Sensepass Retail).
scope_of_work.current_problem: Current platform lacks distance radius filtering, causing visitor drop-off and irrelevant search results. Mobile user experience requires optimization, and key commercial checkout and lead export workflows require automated integration to prevent manual administrative overhead.

scope_of_work.proposed_solution: Implement a cohesive, hybrid solution leveraging Brilliant Directories native configuration for core settings (Google Maps radius, payment gateways, review moderation) and dedicated custom modules where out-of-the-box settings are insufficient, ensuring optimal budget allocation and fast delivery.

REQ-102: PayPal Commerce Platform integration with embedded Smart Payment Buttons. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-103: Multi-tier vendor plans with 14-day free trial (credit card upfront auto-renew) and annual billing. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-104: Admin-managed full and partial refund processing with member subscription lifecycle handling. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-105: Automated transaction notification emails and real-time webhook export to ERP. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
explicit_exclusions: Custom physical inventory warehouse barcode scanner hardware integration.
assumptions_and_dependencies: Client will provide valid administrative API credentials (Google Cloud, Stripe, PayPal).
Brilliant Directories hosted platform uptime and core codebase maintained by vendor.
Work will be verified against agreed acceptance criteria in a dedicated staging environment prior to production launch.
acceptance_criteria: REQ-101: Transactions process on-site via Stripe API without off-site redirects.
REQ-102: On-site PayPal checkout modal executes without external redirect.
REQ-103: 14-day free trial captures card upfront and initiates auto-renew on day 15.
REQ-104: Admins can trigger full or partial refunds from Transaction History modal.
REQ-105: Webhooks post payment payloads to ERP endpoint with retry logging.
client_responsibilities: Provide Google Cloud Console billing account and API keys with Geocoding and Maps JavaScript APIs enabled.
Provide production and sandbox API keys for Stripe and PayPal merchant accounts.
Review and approve staging deployment milestones within 3 business days of delivery.
Supply high-resolution brand assets (transparent PNG logo, 1920x600 hero banner).
open_questions_and_risks: Google Maps API usage quotas: High search volume may incur Google Cloud consumption charges.
Browser geolocation permission: Distance search radius requires end-user browser GPS permission consent.
Third-party API rate limits and webhook delivery guarantees.

This engagement targets delivering an optimized, modern web solution addressing current user friction, integrating verified platform capabilities, and delivering measurable performance improvements within an estimated 5.0-week delivery window.
